title: BGP Underlay Export Policy Removed — dc2-leaf1a stops advertising loopback
symptom: dc2-leaf1a loopback (10.2.1.1) disappears from dc2-spine1 and dc2-spine2 routing tables. EVPN overlay BGP sessions drop as next-hop becomes unreachable.
root_cause: export policy removed from protocols bgp group SPINE-UNDERLAY on dc2-leaf1a — loopback no longer advertised
fix_command: set protocols bgp group SPINE-UNDERLAY export EXPORT-LOOPBACKS
